postal_system.assignment_rule: USPS evidence confirms Puerto Rico ZIP usage and 006–009 prefixes but licensed rows are not redistributed; this pack makes no complete current USPS assignment claim.
postal_system.geometry_rule: 2020 Census ZCTAs are official Census mapping geometry used only as derived statistical display context, never official USPS postal or delivery boundaries.
postal_system.non_area_rule: A ZIP without a Census ZCTA, ZIP+4 delivery code, route, P.O. box or organisation is never expanded into a fabricated area.
postal_system.address_rule: No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer, delivery or land-right row is bundled.
postal_system.agid_rule: Stable postal, geometry, assertion, country and release IDs are exposed; address/building identity needs independent explicit evidence.

quality_gates.pass: Every source receipt is exact-hash gated, Census attribution is retained, and raw USPS licensed data remains out of Git.
All 132 unique fixed-query 2020 Census ZCTAs are published with no USPS-boundary claim.
142 polygon parts, 152 rings and 168,582 positions pass Turf, JSTS and shared topology checks without coordinate modification.
Lookup exposes detailed Census attributes plus postal, geometry, assertion, country and pinned-release IDs.
No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer, land-right or USPS licensed row is published.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights and blockers are inventoried.
Country-specific contracts and provenance are reviewable.

All 132 exact-query 2020 Census ZCTAs load through the API/app, expose stable IDs and attributes, render and fit as translucent derived areas, and clear/re-search without fabricating missing postal areas.
